name: 40172-sharegpt-qwen3next80b-4gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8. Ungated, used as published; 8 fp8 safetensor shards, 82 GB, revision c5f5f263bdd5cc134092897864e8905d8fe7b928.
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, sm90, four cards of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP off; one in-process vLLM engine, about 21 GB of weights per card.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM, an 80B-A3B hybrid decoder: 48 layers with one full-attention layer in four and gated delta net linear attention for the other 36, 512 experts with 10 active plus one shared, fp8 e4m3 weights with the norms, router, gates and lm_head left bf16, and a multi-token-prediction head in the same repo. The rest is readable off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate = 1 req/s, warmup the first 10% by completed requests, bounded at 200 requests with a 1200 s safety cap. The workload arithmetic implies about 200 s of measured time, so the cap is loose on purpose.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, `configs/data/sharegpt-200-qwen3next.jsonl`: 200 real single-turn ShareGPT conversations, plain completions with no chat template, greedy. `ignore_eos` is forced, so each reply is generated to its own recorded length and the run decodes exactly 44697 output tokens. Realised lengths: prompt mean 217.8 tokens (min 4, p50 100, p90 618, max 975), output mean 223.5 (min 4, p50 162, p90 525, max 781). `configs/data/make-dataset.py` writes the file.
purpose: An everyday chat assistant on an 80-billion-parameter sparse model, answering about one conversational request per second across four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 4
speculative-config: {"method": "qwen3_next_mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-model-len: 262144
